headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.rawCoarseMargins_eq
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hr : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hc : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length)
  (z : Math115.ReducedSmallChain.States r c U L),
  Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.rawCoarseMargins (List.ofFn r) (List.ofFn c) U L
      (Math115.PhysicalComputedProposal.computedStateCode r c U L z) =
    (List.ofFn (Math115.LegacyPhysicalCompletion.coarseRows r c U L hr z),
      List.ofFn (Math115.LegacyPhysicalCompletion.coarseColumns r c U L hc z))

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.rawCompletionBits_eq
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hr : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hc : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length)
  (z : Math115.ReducedSmallChain.States r c U L) (h : ℕ),
  Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.rawCompletionBits (List.ofFn r) (List.ofFn c) U L
      (Math115.PhysicalComputedProposal.computedStateCode r c U L z) h =
    Math115.LegacyPhysicalCompletion.bits r c U L hr hc z h

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.rawCompletionResidual_eq
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hr : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hc : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length)
  (z : Math115.ReducedSmallChain.States r c U L) (h N : ℕ)
  (hN : Math115.LegacyPhysicalCompletion.bits r c U L hr hc z h ≤ N) (word : Fin N → Bool),
  Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.rawCompletionResidual (List.ofFn r) (List.ofFn c) U L
      (Math115.PhysicalComputedProposal.computedStateCode r c U L z) h (List.ofFn word) =
    OAI.ContingencyTables.DensePrograms.matrixCode
      ↑((Math115.LegacyPhysicalCompletion.finiteFibreEquiv r c U L hr hc z)
          (Math115.LegacyPhysicalCompletion.completionDraw r c U L hr hc z h
            (OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.prefixWord hN word)))

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.rawCompletionResidual_terminal
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hr : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hc : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length)
  (d : Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L) (h : ℕ)
  (word : Fin (Math115.PhysicalCompletionWidth.uniformCompletionBits r c U L h) → Bool),
  Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.rawCompletionResidual (List.ofFn r) (List.ofFn c) U L
      (Math115.PhysicalComputedProposal.computedStateCode r c U L ↑d) h (List.ofFn word) =
    Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.jointResidualMatrixCode r c U L hr hc
      ⟨d, Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalCompletion r c U L hr hc d h word⟩
